title: Meta Ad Library Scraper

searchQuery.sectionDescription: Enter a keyword, brand name, or topic. Use searchQueries (below) to run multiple searches at once.
searchQuery.title: Search keyword or phrase
searchQuery.description: Keyword or phrase to search in Meta Ad Library. Finds all ads mentioning this term across Facebook, Instagram, and Messenger. Example: 'nike running shoes', 'weight loss', 'crypto'. For MCP/API: pass a plain string.

searchQueries.title: Multiple keywords (batch search)
searchQueries.description: Run several keyword searches in one go. Each keyword is scraped separately and results are merged. Example: ["nike", "adidas", "puma"]. Leave empty if using the single keyword above.

metaAccessToken.sectionDescription: Required for full data (spend, impressions, demographics). Get yours free at developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer → select app → tick ads_read → Generate Access Token. Once entered, the actor remembers it for future runs.
metaAccessToken.title: Meta API Access Token
metaAccessToken.description: Your Meta Graph API access token with ads_read permission. Without it the actor uses web scraping mode (slower, fewer fields). Get a free token at: https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/ Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

countries.sectionDescription: Narrow down which ads to return. All filters are optional — leave as default to get broad results.
countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Countries where the ads were shown. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Examples: US, GB, AU, CA, DE, FR, IN, BR. Default is US. For MCP: pass as array of strings, e.g. ["US", "GB"].

adStatus.title: Ad status
adStatus.description: ACTIVE = ads currently running (best for competitor research). INACTIVE = stopped ads. ALL = both active and inactive.

adType.title: Ad type
adType.description: Type of ads to include. ALL covers standard commercial ads and works without a token. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: Filter by creative format. IMAGE = photo ads only. VIDEO = video ads only. ALL = no filter.

startDate.title: Start date (from)
startDate.description: Only include ads that were running on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2024-01-01. Leave empty for no date filter.

endDate.title: End date (to)
endDate.description: Only include ads that were running on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2024-12-31. Leave empty for no date filter.

maxResults.title: Max ads to return
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ad records to fetch. 50 = quick sample. 100 = standard run. 500–1000 = deep competitive analysis. Higher = more cost. Default: 100.

sortBy.title: Sort results by
sortBy.description: How to order returned ads. impressions_desc = highest-reach ads first (best for finding what's working). most_recent = newest ads first.

enrichAds.title: Enrich with auto-analysis
enrichAds.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrichAds.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

providerFallbackEnabled.title: Restricted access control
providerFallbackEnabled.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

onlyCount.title: Count only (no ad data)
onlyCount.description: Returns only the total number of matching ads without downloading records. Use this to check how many ads exist before running a full scrape. Very fast and cheap.

advertiserPageIds.sectionDescription: For power users and specific use cases. Leave empty to use the standard keyword search above.
advertiserPageIds.title: Advertiser Page IDs
advertiserPageIds.description: Get all ads from specific Facebook Pages by their Page ID. To find a Page ID: go to the page on Facebook → About → Page ID at the bottom. Example: ["123456789", "987654321"]. Use this instead of searchQuery to get all ads from a known brand.

startUrls.title: Ad Library URLs
startUrls.description: Paste URLs directly from facebook.com/ads/library after setting your filters in the browser. The actor extracts all filter parameters automatically. Also accepts Facebook Page URLs to scrape all ads from that page.

adId.title: Single Ad ID
adId.description: Look up one specific ad by its Meta Ad Library ID (a real working example: 820508563651991). Use this to monitor a single ad or verify it still exists. Works with or without a Meta API token; a nonexistent or taken-down ad ID finishes with an INVALID_INPUT warning instead of data.

contentLanguages.title: Content languages
contentLanguages.description: Only return ads written in these languages. Use ISO 639-1 codes: en (English), es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French), pt (Portuguese). Leave empty for all languages.

publisherPlatforms.title: Publisher platforms
publisherPlatforms.description: Filter by which Meta platform the ad ran on. Options: facebook, instagram, messenger, audience_network, threads. Default includes Facebook and Instagram.

searchType.title: Keyword match type
searchType.description: KEYWORD_UNORDERED = all words must appear but in any order (broader). KEYWORD_EXACT_PHRASE = words must appear exactly as typed (narrower).

metaAccessTokens.title: Restricted access control
metaAccessTokens.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

proxyUrls.title: Restricted access control
proxyUrls.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
